visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with short hair and pigtails, wearing a white sleeveless dress with black dots, walks towards the camera in a brightly lit indoor hallway. She is holding a pink and transparent water bottle. (2) The girl stops in front of the camera, looking down at the pink water bottle in her hands. She attempts to manipulate the lid with her small fingers. A pale adult hand enters from the bottom right to reach for the bottle. (3) The adult hand takes hold of the bottle's base while the girl maintains her grip on the handles. The adult's thumb pushes a button on the lid, and the pink cap pops open. The girl watches intently with a neutral expression. (4) The girl reaches for the bottle as the adult holds it back slightly. She appears to be asking for it, with her mouth slightly open and a focused gaze on the container. (5) The girl sits down on the light wood-grain floor, holding the opened bottle with both hands. She looks up at the camera, then brings the straw to her mouth to take a drink. (6) The girl stands back up, turns around, and begins to walk away down the corridor, showing the back of her dress which has a bow at the neck. (7) The video cuts to a static pink background featuring a central cartoon illustration of the girl sitting and drinking, with text appearing below it.
